shopkeeper.text: Come on in! Soda farls, snares, and an Ulster fry, if you've a very big appetite or a very sad week.
Away on with you, and mind the gulls on the quay. They're not hungry. They just like the look of your sandwich.

belfast_bureau.text: Travel money? Belfast's sterling, but cross the border into the Republic and it's euros. We'll sort you out.
